name: The Otis household at 2033 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_otis_f_r

present_on_scene_date.note: The household is listed at 2033 Prairie Avenue in both the 1904 and 1905 editions of the Blue Book, which bracket 1 July 1904, but not with the same people: the 1905 list prints 2033 Mrs. F. R. Otis & dr.; Charles T. Otis; Lucius J. Otis. Each person's own note says which of them the later list drops or adds.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 2033, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The four live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.note: The 1905 edition lists Mrs. F. R. Otis & dr. without him, so his presence on 1 July 1904 is not documented. The 1900 census lists F. R. Otis here as head, born February 1825, in Ohio, married (ED 40, sheet 12B, line 75, leaf n817).

persons.printed_as: 2033 Mr. & Mrs. F. R. Otis & dr.
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Emeline T. Otis here as wife, born May 1830 (the figures are hard to read), in Ohio, married (ED 40, sheet 12B, line 76, leaf n817).

persons.name: Miss Otis
persons.printed_as: 2033 Mr. & Mrs. F. R. Otis & dr.
persons.note: The Blue Book prints '& dr.' after the household's name: an unmarried daughter at home, not named. 'Miss Otis' is the book's own form of address, not a recorded name. The 1900 census lists Marguerite E. Otis here as daughter, born May 1864 (the figures are hard to read), in Ohio, single (ED 40, sheet 12B, line 79, leaf n817).
